title: Beginner Gym Plan: Dad and Mum
author: Davis
desc:
This 4-week program is designed for beginner parents looking to build muscle strength. With 4 sessions per week, you'll focus on key compound movements using full gym equipment. Each 50-minute workout targets major muscle groups, ensuring a balanced approach to fitness. Expect to feel stronger and more energized as you progress. 

Helpful instructions on form and auto timers are included in the program.
